title: Chapter 723 - 723 Growing Black Pot; Increasing Favorability!
content:
Chapter 723 - 723 Growing Black Pot; Increasing Favorability!

Chapter 723 - 723 Growing Black Pot; Increasing Favorability!

723 Growing Black Pot; Increasing Favorability!

[Too handsome. Level 5 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator, Myriad Demon Sect Master. Lin Yulian was the enemy of the immortal phoenix in her previous life. She knew that the immortal phoenix had a backup plan, so she had already planned to wait for the reincarnation of the immortal phoenix to come. Now, she suspected that Lin Yulian was the reincarnation of the immortal phoenix, so she attacked her.]

Emperor level 5!

After Zhu Yan, this was the second Emperor level being who had interacted with Lin Fan.

Ever since Lin Fan became a King level being, he could now check the levels of King and Emperor level beings.

[Do you wish to use one million spirit stones to curse Taijun?]

Lin Fan had already cursed Zhu Yan, who was a monarch level being, to death. Now that he was going to curse another one, he would not feel any burden at all.

“Yes, sir!”

Suddenly, a large number of spirit stones in the inner space shattered and turned into flowing lights that filled the sky and disappeared.

….

At this moment, in the Thearch Palace of the Demon Region.

Tai Jun sat on the bench, quietly listening to his subordinate’s report.

At this moment, a wisp of black gas suddenly spread out from Tai Jun’s body. He raised his eyebrows and forcefully suppressed the black gas.

Although the time was very short.

However, it also attracted the attention of many people.

“I’ve been cursed!” Tai Jun’s expression was ugly as he said.”

As soon as he said this, the entire hall immediately fell silent.

Curse!

This was definitely the most terrifying thing that had happened.

That was because the Fire God Palace’s Palace Master, Zhu Yan, had died due to the curse not long ago.

It was also because of the curse that the Fire God Palace had fallen from a top-tier faction to a second-tier faction.

“Right now, attacking the Demon Sect is the top priority!” Tai Jun said in a deep voice.”

Clearly, he thought that the person who cursed him was from the demonic sect.

It was no wonder that he would think so.

After all, before Zhu Yan died, he had already announced to the world that the Demon Sect Master had cursed him.

Such a terrifying curse must have come from the same person.

In addition, the Ten Thousand Fey Sect had indeed been killing the fiend sects in the past few years.

The Demon Sect Master had a reason to deal with him.

“Yes!” The members of the Ten Thousand Demon Sect said in unison.”

Therefore, the Myriad Demon Sect launched the most intense encirclement and suppression against the demonic sect.

There was no such thing as an impenetrable wall in the world.

The news of Tai Jun being cursed by the Demon Sect Master quickly spread.

After the Water God Palace’s Palace Lord and the Lightning Sect’s Sect Master learned of this, they also began to increase their attacks on the fiend sects.

That was because unknown and powerful forces were the most terrifying.

They were also worried that they would also be cursed by the Demon Sect Master.

After the Demon Sect received the news, they felt like they were eating coptis root in silence.

No matter how they explained, no one believed them.

The black pot was getting bigger and bigger.

….

Lin Fan didn’t care about any of this at all.

He always maintained the rhythm of being too handsome whenever he had free time.

Five years passed in a flash.

“Roar!”

Tai Jun roared at the sky, bursting out with a powerful gale that sent everyone in the palace flying. His entire person became like a demon king, incomparably ferocious.

“Kill, kill, kill!”

“I want to kill everything!”

….

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! [Your enemy is too handsome. Due to your curse, his inner demons have greatly increased.]]

Lin Fan said softly,” Finally, the heart demon has grown?” As a celebration, let’s have a curse set meal.”

“Whoosh!”

The one million Spiritual Stones in the inner space shattered and turned into a stream of light that disappeared.

Then, Lin Fan used his soul to communicate with Ma Zheng.

After all, Ma Zheng was now his subordinate.

It was not good to not contact each other for too long.

“Ma Zheng.”

….

Ma Zheng, who was sitting cross-legged, suddenly opened his eyes.

Even though he didn’t see Lin Fan, he still knelt on the ground and said respectfully,””Master!”

Lin Fan said,” How’s the situation recently?”

“I’ve already joined the Raincloud Altar, a subsidiary force of the Water God Palace. Furthermore, I’ve become a team leader of the Raincloud Altar…” Ma Zheng replied.

It had to be said that Ma Zheng was indeed quite capable.

No matter what, the Raincloud Sanctum was a rather famous faction.

It was not easy to achieve such an achievement in just a few years.

The reason why Ma Zheng was so respectful to Lin Fan was because he had joined the Raincloud Sanctum.

This was because the Raincloud Sanctum had its own intelligence network.

Ma Zheng heard that the Insect Emperor and the King of the Insect Realm had both died from a curse.

In addition, the Fire God Palace Lord and the Myriad Demon Sect’s Sect Master were also subjected to a terrifying curse.

Among them, the Fire God Palace Lord was dead, and the Myriad Demon Sect’s Sect Master had become a demon.

Now, the various universes were saying that this was all done by the Demon King.

However, Ma Zheng had a feeling that perhaps…This was done by Lin Fan.

If that was the case, how strong would Lin Fan be?

Every time Ma Zheng thought about it, his heart would be filled with endless admiration for Lin Fan.

He understood that he had followed a truly important person!

This was also the reason why Ma Zheng was so respectful to Lin Fan.

Lin Fan was satisfied,” Not bad!” What realm are you at now?”

“Master, I’m currently at the 6th level of the planet realm.”Ma Zheng said.

In a few years, his cultivation had increased by one level. The speed was not bad.

Lin Fan muttered,” It’s still a little slow. How about this? I’ll teach you a breathing technique.””

Hence, Lin Fan imparted the Xuanhuang Breathing Technique to him.

After ending the soul communication, Ma Zheng inhaled and exhaled according to the breathing technique.

“Whoosh!”

The spiritual energy in the air surged into his body like a tidal wave.

Ma Zheng suddenly realized that one breath of his was comparable to several days of bitter cultivation!

If this continued, how fast would his cultivation speed be?

This was definitely an amazing breathing technique!

Ma Zheng, who had just stood up, knelt on the ground again and said firmly,”Thank you, Master! Thank you, Master!”

….

[Ding! Ma Zheng’s favorability towards you has increased to 8 stars.]

When Lin Fan heard this, his face revealed a look of satisfaction.

He had not taught her the breathing technique in vain.

Then, Lin Fan looked up at Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hu Tian, and Huang Ling who were cultivating hard. As well as Little Rock, Li Ke, and Qin Menghu.

Their cultivation had all increased greatly, and it was still increasing at every moment.

However, it was still not enough. Moreover, some people seemed to have deviated from the norm.

Hence, Lin Fan took a step forward and appeared before everyone.

When Hu Tian, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Su Ningjing, and the others saw Lin Fan, their faces immediately bloomed like flowers.

“Lin Fan!” they said happily.

Little Rock, Li Ke, Qin Menghu, Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, Riemann, and the others bowed and said in a respectful and excited tone,””Greetings, Master!”

Master?

That’s right!

It was Master.

At first, Li Ke, Qin Menghu, Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann wanted to be Lin Fan’s disciples.

But now, they no longer had such thoughts.

Because they felt that they were not worthy.

Didn’t they see that their big brother, Little Rock, also called Lin Fan Master?

Lin Fan nodded at everyone and said,” Today, we will solve the problems you have encountered in your cultivation.”

P.S. Welcome to my final book, Super Red Envelope Immortals.
